title: Gotcha: stale_flags health check and FeatureFlagStatusChecker lack v2 guard
answers: Do health checks handle v2 flag filters?
Where might a v2 flag be misread as v1?
body: `temporal/health_checks/stale_flags.py:_serves_more_than_one_result` / `_sole_served_variant` and `flag_status.py:FeatureFlagStatusChecker` read `filters["groups"]`/`multivariate` without calling `detect_config_format`. A v2 flag would likely be read as a v1 flag with no groups. Not run to confirm (inferred from grep/reads). Add a guard if touching these.
applies: Only until a detect_config_format guard is added there.
